items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I don't know your real full name. I don't know what J is for. Joseph. Joseph, okay.

ctx.x: I don't know your real full name. I don't know what J is for. Joseph. Joseph, okay.

So, what is your real name? My last name is Pecoraro, but I cut it down to Pecoraro. You just called yourself Santa Pecoraro? Yes, and it's a funny thing, then it was about 19, oh, let me see, 19, 20, around 20, Johnny Vittroy started calling me Peck instead of Pecoraro, see? And then when I went to Chicago, they used to make my check out, Peck Pecoraro instead of going to be a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit of a little bit. So, I stayed in Chicago 15 years, and when I went to…
